scope: Additive US observed field and plot dataset candidates; metadata research only, no acquisition/admission

candidates.title: The Bronson Files, Dataset 8, Field 113, 2016
candidates.spatial_support: experimental cotton plot polygons and geolocated proximal passes
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: One research farm. Plot polygons are described but their actual coordinate format and joins require inspection. Related Field 113 2017–18 and Field 13/17 files belong to the Bronson/Maricopa family; calculated vegetation indices are model/processing output.
candidates.access_status: public individual files; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Inspect small dictionary, operations, and workbook for plot/time join; candidate for research-grade treatment and spectral alignment, with farm-level holdout only after other farms are found.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in 51-entry catalog. Do not count separate Bronson years/fields as independent farms.

candidates.title: Historical trends in the nitrogen requirement of corn over 45 years in Ohio
candidates.site: 31 Ohio counties; on-farm and research-station trials
candidates.spatial_support: trial/site-year with plot or treatment-mean rows; county location only
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: 431 rainfed N-response trials, 5,778 crop rows. Some rows are treatment means, others raw plots. Same farm may recur; county geography blocks field-level satellite joins and independent-farm count is unverified.
candidates.access_status: public file manifest verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Offline grouped nitrogen-response analysis after separating raw-plot and treatment-mean records; no field-imagery target.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; distinct from 49-site-year Midwest N-rate Dryad archive.

candidates.title: Soybean yield response to phosphorus rate and Mehlich-3 soil P in Arkansas
candidates.site: Eastern Arkansas private production fields and experiment stations; 8 counties
candidates.spatial_support: 39 site-year trials with plot treatments; source metadata gives point coordinates for many trial sites
observed_targets: Mehlich-3 soil nutrients, pH, organic matter
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: 39 sites/site-years reported, but repeated station/farm groups require file-level deduplication. Plot harvested areas are given, not verified plot polygons. SoyMap R1 dates are predictions; do not relabel as observed phenology.
candidates.access_status: public individual workbook; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: High-priority soil-test/response study; validate site-point mapping and farm grouping before spatial holdout.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog. Different crops/protocols from Midwest N-rate archive.

candidates.title: High-yielding corn response to applied P, K, and S in Nebraska
candidates.site: Diverse irrigated corn sites across Nebraska
candidates.spatial_support: site-year nutrient trial table; exact geometry not verified
observed_targets: soil test nutrients, pH, organic matter
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: 34 site-years are reported; independent physical site count and coordinates unverified. Main XLS is 51.5 MB, above the entire 20 MiB sample envelope. README is small.
candidates.access_status: public files; metadata verified; main data not acquired
candidates.proposed_use: Catalog for future bounded extraction; inspect README now, defer large workbook pending storage plan.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; possible geographic overlap with Midwest N-rate trials, cross-check site IDs and dates.

candidates.title: Soybean starter fertilizer in rolled-crimped cereal rye
candidates.site: Organic field sites in New York and Wisconsin
candidates.spatial_support: plot, block, treatment, site-year; no plot coordinates
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Five site-years span two states, but exact physical-farm grouping is not established. Soil variables are block-level; plot yield is a separate table. No imagery-ready geometry.
candidates.access_status: public small CSV files; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Compact multi-site plot response and phenology join; use blocked site-year assessment, not field imagery.

candidates.title: Sclerotinia stem rot control and soybean yield North Central trials
candidates.site: Illinois, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, New Jersey, Wisconsin
candidates.spatial_support: plot-level treatment and disease/yield table; no published geometry verified
observed_targets: pesticide active ingredient and application timing
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: 2,057 plot records across 25 site-years; independent farms and exact coordinates unknown. Workbook title says without non-treated, so control availability and treatment comparisons need checking. Pesticide records are historic evidence, not current label authority.
candidates.access_status: public workbooks; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Offline disease/yield association and treatment-record parsing only; preserve pesticide-authority exclusion.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; not the GRACEnet network.

candidates.title: Thirteen-year stover harvest and tillage effects on corn in Iowa
candidates.site: Iowa State University Ag Engineering and Agronomy Farm, Boone; Fields 70–71
candidates.spatial_support: longitudinal research plots with one farm coordinate
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: One research farm; two fields and many years are not independent farms. No plot polygons verified. Treatments changed over time, including discontinuation of no-till/no-harvest in 2012 and biochar introduction in 2013; consult plot-status workbook.
candidates.access_status: public individual files; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Longitudinal treatment/soil/yield joins and change-point QA at one station.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; check possible site-level overlap with other Iowa research-farm datasets.

candidates.title: Soil health and tomato yield after hairy vetch in US high tunnels
candidates.site: Kansas, Kentucky, Minnesota organic high tunnels
candidates.time: three years at each site; published 2026
candidates.spatial_support: replicated high-tunnel plots at three sites
observed_targets: soil nitrate, C/N, microbial biomass and enzyme activity
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Three geographically separate sites are explicit; one Minnesota site-year failed overwintering and was excluded. High-tunnel crop geometry and microclimate are not comparable with broadacre HLS imagery.
candidates.access_status: public workbooks; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Small independent-site soil/cover-crop/yield benchmark for tabular agronomy only.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; tomato/high-tunnel domain distinct.

candidates.title: Barley and mustard cover crop effects on New Mexico chile pepper
candidates.site: Leyendecker and Los Lunas New Mexico research centers
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Two sites, two growing years. Yield is hand-harvested from an 8 m row transect and scaled to hectare. No plot geocoordinates shown; weed germination assay is controlled-environment follow-up, not field observation. License metadata API not queried because Dryad throttled.
candidates.access_status: public page and file links; source-specific license pending; no bytes acquired
candidates.proposed_use: Tabular observed weed and yield response after rights check; exclude controlled-environment assay from field labels.

candidates.title: Breaking the field phenotyping bottleneck in maize with autonomous robots
candidates.country: United States and Canada (US case studies only)
candidates.site: US and Canada study; US case-study locations include Illinois and two on-farm N-trial sites
candidates.time: five-year overall program; deposited case studies include 2022
candidates.spatial_support: research plot x-y range grid within field; geographic coordinates not established
observed_targets: manual plant/ear height and stem width
robot sensor measurements with modeled trait estimates
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Abstract describes 142 fields and ~200,000 experimental units, but deposited workbook is selected case studies, not the full archive. Do not infer 142 independent accessible groups. Robot-derived traits are processed model outputs; separate manual validation measures.
candidates.access_status: public small workbooks; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Phenotype sensor-versus-manual validation and within-field plot joins after checking which tabs contain measured yield.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; potential broad maize-trial overlap with G2F cannot be excluded without site identifiers.

candidates.title: Sugarcane genotype by environment clonal trials in Texas Rio Grande Valley
candidates.site: later-stage off-station Texas sugarcane farms, 4–5 locations per planting series
candidates.spatial_support: breeding plot × genotype × location × ratoon crop
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Four planting series have unique sets of locations; exact unique farm count is unverified. Second workbook derives ratooning index from the same raw yield data and is not an independent source. Plot geometry is not reported.
candidates.access_status: public workbooks; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Source-distinct multi-location yield and genotype interaction analysis; block by location and series.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; not G2F maize.

candidates.title: Hyperspectral reflectance for multi-site cotton growth monitoring
candidates.site: USDA-ARS El Reno Oklahoma and Temple Texas field research stations
candidates.time: 2019 Oklahoma and 2022 Texas; measurement dates included in CSV
observed_targets: in-situ plant height, node count, LAI, chlorophyll
N treatment in Oklahoma; planting-date and cultivar factors in Texas
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: Two named research stations. CSV includes measurement dates; exact plot coordinates and plot identifiers require schema inspection. Canopy cover is derived from image pixels and ML trait predictions must be separated from in-situ measurements. No yield is claimed.
candidates.access_status: public CSV manifest; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Candidate independent-station spectral/growth comparison once raw observation columns and dates are checked.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; distinct from Bronson Maricopa cotton.

candidates.title: USDA-ARS Colorado Maize Water Productivity Dataset 2012–2013
candidates.site: Limited Irrigation Research Farm, northeastern Colorado
candidates.spatial_support: replicated irrigation treatment plot-year; plot map PDF
observed_targets: harvest index, biomass, LAI, stand density
candidates.geometry_timing_limitations: One station. Associated 2008–2011 record is same trial family, not another independent farm. Crop ET values include estimates; distinguish from plot observations. Plot map needs georeference review before imagery join.
candidates.access_status: public individual files; metadata verified; no bytes acquired by researcher
candidates.proposed_use: Observed plot-level irrigation/yield and growth-stage benchmark with single-site caveat.
candidates.overlap_check: No DOI/title in old catalog; Colorado sunflower is separate crop/station, check proximity and treatment protocols.
